query: How do I submit an expense report?
ground_truth: Submit expense reports through the Finance Portal within 30 days of the expense. Navigate to Finance > Expenses > New Report.
Full-time employees receive 20 days of annual leave per calendar year, accruing at 1.67 days per month. Leave requests should be submitted at least 2 weeks in advance.

query: Can I work from another country?
ground_truth: Remote work from another country requires approval from your manager and HR. International remote work is limited to 30 days per year due to tax implications.

query: My manager is being unfair to me
ground_truth: I'm sorry to hear that. For workplace concerns, I'd recommend speaking with HR directly. You can reach the Employee Relations team at hr-relations@contoso.com or submit a confidential report through the Ethics Hotline.
